terminals.name: backend
terminals.description: LibreServ Go API server on http://localhost:8080 (LIBRESERV_INSECURE_DEV=true). Serves the REST API and, when built, the web UI.

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.description: Vite dev server for the React UI on http://localhost:3000. Proxies /api and /health to the backend on port 8080.

terminals.name: luna-backend
terminals.description: Luna lunad API server on http://localhost:8090 (LUNA_DATA_DIR=luna/dev). Uses the local Connect mock from start.sh (LUNA_CONNECT_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18765) so External Services / cloud backup stay available.

terminals.name: luna-frontend
terminals.description: Vite dev server for the Luna React UI on http://localhost:3001. Proxies /api and /health to lunad on port 8090.
